policy.bias: 1h EMA20 versus EMA50; 4h close versus EMA20 with 3-bar EMA slope. Agreement is aligned; otherwise reduced exposure.
policy.flip: Completed 3m close breaks preceding ten 3m highs/lows and is above/below EMA21, confirmed by last observable 1m bullish/bearish candle. Opposite breakout closes and reverses; initial direction follows nonzero 1h bias.
policy.levels: Prior twenty 3m high/low (60m) and rolling 24h typical-price VWAP. These are explicit OHLCV proxies, not actual volume-at-price supply/demand or discretionary trader replication.
policy.slices: Initial two units, maintain one to four units; aligned direction up to 80% of exposure cap, other direction half that. One unit is capped by 0.5% initial account risk at a 3m 2ATR adverse stop and current minimum quantity. Freeze unit quantity and stop for each directional campaign; additions never widen stop or increase campaign risk beyond current 0.5% equity budget.
policy.trim: 1m high/low touches prior 60m resistance/support within 0.15 ATR3, closes back inside with reversal candle, and net liquidation PnL per unit is positive; remove one unit, at most once per three minutes.
policy.reload: 1m touches prior 60m support/resistance or 24h VWAP within 0.25 ATR3 and closes back across with reversal candle; add one unit if remaining risk and exposure permit; at most once per three minutes.
policy.exit: Completed 1m adverse extreme crosses campaign stop, or holding reaches 1440m: close. Reverse immediately only with a separately confirmed opposite signal; otherwise reenter on next eligible decision. Risk halt overrides all entries.
policy.control: Same exogenous direction signals and stop/time rules, fixed initial two units, no trims or reloads. Different exposure makes this a policy comparison, not an exposure-matched alpha estimate.

execution: All signals use completed bars available at least one full minute earlier. Market fills at next modeled minute open plus adverse tick/slippage; close-before-open for reversal, both at same reference open. No assumed passive fills. Funding before orders for positions held through settlement; events rounded up to next minute. Stop excursions are detected after completed bars, exited at subsequent modeled open, never filled at an unobserved stop price.
risk: Observe mark-price open each minute and halt at 4% from observed mark-equity high water; complete minute high/low envelope reports conservative drawdown, so delayed exit may exceed threshold. Intraminute mark extrema ordering is unknown. Maintenance margin/account liquidation not validated. No actual leverage setting or orders.
study: 24 continuous accounts: two policies x three exposure caps x two trading costs x two operating costs. Additionally 192 independent one-month trials at 3x: 24 months x two policies x two costs x two operating costs. Each monthly trial starts with fresh 1000 and is NOT a continuously executable strategy or a drawdown reset permission. Report all months, including halted and zero-trade months. Historical data reused; exploratory, no parameter tuning.
